headline.en: See which recorded edits remain in HEAD.
headline.zh: 看清记录的编辑哪些留在 HEAD。

sub.en: Survmap extracts file edits from a saved Claude Code transcript and compares their substantive lines with the repository’s current HEAD.
sub.zh: Survmap 从保存的 Claude Code 轨迹提取文件编辑，将其中实质内容行与仓库当前 HEAD 比较。

body.en: Scores refer back to specific edit turns.
body.zh: 评分对应具体编辑轮次。

body.en: Matches retain paths and HEAD line information.
body.zh: 匹配保留路径与 HEAD 行信息。

body.en: The scorer needs no model request.

title.en: Run it on a complete example

note.en: Two explicit synthetic edit turns are compared with supplied HEAD lines through the production scorer.
note.zh: 通过生产评分器，把两轮明确合成编辑与提供的 HEAD 行比较。

steps.label: Recorded run
steps.body: Production content-presence scorer over two explicit synthetic turns and supplied HEAD lines; no real repository history or productivity measurement.

turn-1: partial; survived=1 churned=1

body.en: Two explicit synthetic edit turns are compared with supplied HEAD lines through the production scorer.
body.zh: 通过生产评分器，把两轮明确合成编辑与提供的 HEAD 行比较。

steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/SuperMarioYL/survmap.git
cd survmap
go build .

limitations.en: Content survival is not a productivity or value measurement. Similar lines can exist for unrelated reasons.
limitations.zh: 内容存留不等于生产力或价值；相似内容也可能因无关原因存在。

limitations.en: The parser supports Claude Code’s recorded tool-use shape; arbitrary Codex transcripts are not established as supported.
limitations.zh: 解析器支持 Claude Code 的 tool-use 记录形状，不代表任意 Codex 轨迹均受支持。

limitations.en: The offline demo supplies explicit synthetic HEAD lines. It does not test a repository history walk.
limitations.zh: 离线示例显式提供合成 HEAD 行，不测试仓库历史遍历。

body.en: The final diff hides intermediate rewrites. A per-turn content-presence report helps locate where work was retained or replaced, so you can inspect those turns directly.
body.zh: 最终 diff 隐去了中间改写过程。逐轮内容存留报告帮助定位保留或替换的工作，便于回到相应轮次检查。

body.en: The session parser extracts Write, Edit, MultiEdit and NotebookEdit records. The Git reader obtains HEAD content and best-effort blame data. The scorer matches substantive lines in order, then aggregates survived, churned, partial and skipped turns.
body.zh: 会话解析器提取 Write、Edit、MultiEdit 与 NotebookEdit；Git 读取器获取 HEAD 内容与尽力解析的 blame 数据。评分器按顺序匹配实质内容行，汇总 survived、churned、partial 和 skipped。

body.en: The session parser extracts Write, Edit, MultiEdit and NotebookEdit records. The Git reader obtains HEAD content and best-effort blame data. The scorer matches substantive lines in order, then aggregates survived, churned, partial and skipped turns.
body.zh: 会话解析器提取 Write、Edit、MultiEdit 与 NotebookEdit；Git 读取器获取 HEAD 内容与尽力解析的 blame 数据。评分器按顺序匹配实质内容行，汇总 survived、churned、partial 和 skipped。

body.en: The following routes are implemented in the source. Choose the input that matches your task and keep the resulting artifact with your project.
body.zh: 以下路径已有源码实现。按任务选择输入，并把生成的结果与项目一起保存。

body.en: --repo/-r selects the repository root; use the actual repository corresponding to the transcript. Only committed HEAD content is used. Blank lines and bare braces are excluded from scoring; trailing whitespace is ignored in line comparison.
body.zh: --repo/-r 指定仓库根目录，应使用轨迹对应的实际仓库。比较使用已提交的 HEAD 内容；空行和单独花括号不参与计分，行末空白在比较时忽略。

body.en: The CLI exposes the following operations. Commands after the example use your own paths or identifiers.
body.zh: CLI 提供以下操作。示例之外的命令需要替换成你的文件路径或标识。

details.code:
go run . score examples/sample.jsonl --repo /path/to/your/repo
go run . heatmap examples/sample.jsonl --repo /path/to/your/repo
go run . heatmap examples/sample.jsonl --repo /path/to/your/repo --html survival.html
